items.title: Dave Pell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: featured sidemen included Benny Carter, Pepper Adams and Art Pepper

ctx.x: Saxophonist and band leader Dave Pell has had a variety of jobs in the music world. A native of New York, he was born in 1925 and made the move to the west coast in the late 40s. Dave was employed by Bob Crosby and Les Brown, learning skills that would enable him to lead the very successful Dave Pell Octet. This ensemble found a commercial niche in the jazz market and featured sidemen included Benny Carter, Pepper Adams and Art Pepper. Dave was interviewed by Monk Rowe before a performance by The Prez Conference at the Sarasota Jazz Festival on April 11, 1996.
